physiological_plausibility.reason: Peripheral channel units and preprocessing in the preprocessed release are not documented in available sources. GSR has negative values due to drift subtraction (Koelstra et al. 2012, p. 10: low-frequency drift removed by 256-point moving average subtraction). Temp channel is on incompatible scales across participants (s01-s23 and s25 show baseline-corrected small values; s24 and s26-s32 show extreme raw values; source of split unknown). Resp and BVP units are not stated in the paper.

timeliness.reason: All 40 channels share a single sample clock per participant. No cross-device temporal alignment is needed.
